prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Choose a companion that lives right on your desktop, ready to help, play, and keep you company as you work."]
1: ["Meet Your New Companion", "Here are your companion's initial traits and abilities.", "Companion Verified", "Your pet will react to desktop activity and quick commands."]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "Initializing companion graphics renderer and system integration."]
3: ["Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!", "Use the tray icon to quickly access controls, change pet status, or customize interactions."]
4: ["Sign In to Save Your Companion", "Signing in links your pet adoption to your account so you never lose your companion.", "Your pet state and stats are automatically backed up."]
5: ["Automatic Cloud Save Enabled"]
6: ["All paths include lifetime cloud backup and free starter accessories."]
7: ["Adoption Certificate Verified", "Your official adoption document is ready. Click finish to summon your pet to your desktop.", "Summon Companion Now"]
8: ["If your pet doesn't display immediately, check your system tray icon."]
9: ["Right-click tray icon to open menu | Double-click pet to play | Press Esc to hide pet"]
